docs.title: Home
docs.text: # Welcome to my Digital Fabrication and Modeling Documentation Website  Welcome to my Digital Fabrication and Modeling Documentation Website, a comprehensive record of my learning journey throughout the course. This platform captures my design decisions, technical explorations, and fabrication workflows, reflecting both conceptual understanding and hands-on practice.    The documentation is developed using MkDocs with the Material theme and is fully version-controlled with GitHub, ensuring transparency, traceability of changes, and continuous publication of updated content.  ## Professional Background  My name is NIYOMUGENGA Prosper, and I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering. I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Internet of Things (IoT), where my academic focus is on embedded systems, connected devices, and intelligent technologies.

docs.title: Course Documentation Overview
docs.text:
This documentation site is structured to guide you through my digital modeling and fabrication learning journey. You can navigate through:

  • Documentation Manual – Guides on setup, workflow, modeling, and fabrication
  • Daily Documentation – Daily progress logs including design decisions, screenshots, and fabrication notes
  • Reflection – Lessons learned, critical analysis, and improvements throughout the course

Each section combines text explanations, images, diagrams, and step-by-step workflows to provide a complete understanding of the design and fabrication process.
